name: product-back
prompt:
Premium photographic product campaign. Reference1 is authoritative real belt, reference2 is correct lower-abdomen worn positioning/scale, reference3 original logo. Preserve actual pastel pink elongated low-profile rounded rectangular shell. Black vertical oval UNLIT display on VIEWER LEFT, two small gold leaf forms on left rim and small blue protective pull tab on right rim. Original black PRINCESS with BLOOM below marking center-right, embossed pink HEART at far right. Gray terrycloth padded BACK, pink woven adjustable strap and pink buckle. Never gray straps, no mirrored product, no screen right, no invented temperature display or features, no thickening or redesign. Real camera photography, soft natural light, warm ivory/blush cream palette, realistic materials and skin, no illustration, no watermarks or text overlays. ONE independent photograph, NEVER collage or montage.
SCENE: Use case product-mockup. Landscape 3:2 macro studio photograph of BACK SIDE of actual belt from reference1 bottom-right, gray soft terrycloth padded rounded rectangle, pastel pink elastic woven strap arranged as loop and pink plastic buckle, faithfully recreate this side of the real object. Offwhite blush tabletop, diffused window light, authentic seams and cloth loops. Rear only, so no front screen or lettering visible. Product occupies 75%width.
